text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I escort Meisho Doto to the infirmary
after she
suffers an injury during training.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry! I'm so sorry!
I'm always causing
you
trouble... Oogh.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I promise I'll be back to training as soon

as—Ouch!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-but... I won't have any confidence to
spare if I
stop now...
choice_data_list: If it hurts, let's call it a day.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I can still keep going! This injury won't
h-hold me
down!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I can still keep going! This injury won't
h-hold me
back!
choice_data_list: I want you to rest quietly for now.
Want to head back to training?
Want to head back to training?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
But, I really can't stand to stay
put... If
the pain
gets too bad, I'll stop. So,
please!
choice_data_list: I want you to rest quietly for now.
Want to head back to training?
Want to head back to training?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: W-well...
choice_data_list: It might take longer to heal.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: All right... I'll get some rest.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Guh... I've made a big mess of things
with this
injury... I'm so sorry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto swallows her
disappointment,
choosing to rest until
she's fully healed.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-yes, of course! Thank you so much,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I p-promise!
I'll stop if the pain gets too
much!
choice_data_list: I want you to promise me you won't...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Careful now...
It should be fine if I don't
use too
much strength.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-owowowwww!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
That was a fraction of my strength... Urk,
I can't
walk like this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Exerting any level of force seems to be a
taxing
endeavor, and her injury only
worsens.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh... I... think I can manage still. With
just a bit
more effort, maybe—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-yes! That's right. I have that...
promise
to keep!
choice_data_list: Let's dial it back a bit!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto keeps her strength in
check,
successfully returning to practice!
